label.administrable_evidence: The HPG program is a grant program which provides qualified public agencies, private nonprofit organizations, which may include but not be limited to, Faith-Based and Community Organizations, and other eligible entities grant funds to assist very low- and low-income homeowners in repairing and rehabilitating their homes in rural areas.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The HPG program assists in overcoming persistent health disparities by providing housing assistance to low-income individuals, which can improve their overall health and well-being.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The HPG program does not directly align with the DMVA strategic plan goals.
